articles.title: Cathie Wood Funds Buy Shares Of OpenAI As Its Valuation Grows Again
articles.mainIdea: Cathie Wood Funds Buy Shares Of OpenAI As Its Valuation Grows Again
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Cathie Wood Funds Buy Shares Of OpenAI As Its Valuation Grows Again. Three of investor Cathie Wood's ARK Invest funds now include OpenAI, giving small investors a chance to own the artificial intelligence stock before it goes public. In disclosures late Tuesday, ARK Invest said its ARK Innovation, ARK Next Generation Internet and ARK Blockchain & Fintech ETFs have about 3% of their portfolios invested in OpenAI. The holding is about $122 billion in ARK Blockchain and nearly $43 billion in ARK Next Generation Internet. Related tickers mentioned: ARK-USD, ARKF, ARKK.

articles.summary: Benzinga: Cathie Wood Going Cold On Big Tech? Ark Sells Nvidia, AMD, Meta And Google Stock — AI Darlings Get The Dump. On Thursday, Cathie Wood-led Ark Invest executed significant trades, focusing on reducing holdings in major tech companies. Among the prominent trades were the sales of shares in Meta Platforms Inc., NVIDIA Corp, Advanced Micro Devices Inc., Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd, Broadcom Inc., Alphabet Inc., and Netflix Inc.. These trades reflect a strategic shift in Ark’s investment approach amid market fluctuations.
